subject.title: Add optional `name`/`label` field to group config entries

question: Which single public metadata field name and cross-channel scope should OpenClaw accept for group config entries?
rationale: This changes the public configuration contract, and repository policy favors one canonical config shape rather than multiple aliases or per-channel drift.

options.title: Adopt `name` everywhere
options.body: Use one optional `name?: string` metadata field across relevant group-entry schemas, types, generated metadata, docs, and tests while keeping runtime behavior unchanged.

options.title: Choose another canonical field
options.body: Use a different single field such as `label` or `description`, but still apply it consistently across the same config surfaces.

options.title: Decline config metadata
options.body: Keep group entries behavior-only and leave readability to docs, external notes, or channel-specific runtime naming features.

recommendation.title: Adopt `name` everywhere
recommendation.body: Use one optional `name?: string` metadata field across relevant group-entry schemas, types, generated metadata, docs, and tests while keeping runtime behavior unchanged.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current history signal on strict config schemas and already framed this exact issue as a config-contract decision.
